# Composio AI Product Ops — 100-App Toolkit & MCP Buildability Research

> Automated 3-pass research and verification study of 100 SaaS, developer, fintech, and AI apps across 10 categories, cross-checked against 1,842 live Composio v3.1 toolkits.
> Generated: 2026-11-23 | Live Case Study: https://composio-productops-assignment.vercel.app | Source Repo: https://github.com/shrihari808/composio-productops-assignment

## Machine-Readable Artifacts
- [Final Verified Dataset](https://composio-productops-assignment.vercel.app/data/final_results.json): All 100 verified app records with auth, access model, API surface, MCP status, Composio catalog metadata, URL health, and verification change logs.
- [Aggregated Analytics Summary](https://composio-productops-assignment.vercel.app/data/analytics_summary.json): Distributions, 10-category cross-tab matrix, Build vs. Wrap tool depth breakdown, and prioritized Composio action queues.
- [Deep Composio Catalog Audit](https://composio-productops-assignment.vercel.app/data/composio_catalog_deep.json): Live `/api/v3.1/toolkits` scan across 1,842 toolkits (81 matched apps, 14,555 tools, auth modes, triggers).
- [Human & Browser Audit Log](https://composio-productops-assignment.vercel.app/data/human_audit.json): Stratified 20-app live-docs and browser audit scoring Pass 1 (50.0%) -> Pass 2 (80.0%) -> Final (100.0%).
- [Automated Pass 2 Diff Report](https://composio-productops-assignment.vercel.app/data/verification_diff_report.json): All 30 automated field corrections across 29 apps with primary-source evidence.
- [Composio Live Execution Proof](https://composio-productops-assignment.vercel.app/data/composio_live_proof.json): Auditable Composio Platform SDK `session_id` and `log_id` records for `exa`, `github`, `deepwiki_mcp`, and `mermaid_chart_mcp`.
- [Pass 1 Raw Baseline](https://composio-productops-assignment.vercel.app/data/pass1_results.json): Immutable Pass 1 research snapshot before automated verification.
- [Pass 2 Verified Snapshot](https://composio-productops-assignment.vercel.app/data/pass2_verified.json): Snapshot after automated Pass 2 checks and before Pass 3 human overrides.
- [Validated Pipeline Architecture (Mermaid)](https://composio-productops-assignment.vercel.app/assets/architecture.mmd): 3-pass research & verification architecture validated via Composio `mermaid_chart_mcp`.

## Headline Metrics
- Total Apps Analyzed: 100 (10 categories x 10 apps)
- Buildability Verdicts: {"Ready Today (Easy Win)": 50, "Buildable with Friction": 43, "Gated / Needs Outreach": 5, "Blocked / Not API-Native": 2}
- Auth Methods Frequency (multi-select): {"OAuth2": 88, "API Key": 64, "Bearer Token": 62, "Basic Auth": 21, "JWT": 10, "App Token / Bot Token": 7, "HMAC / Signature": 6, "Other": 4, "No Auth / Open": 3, "CLI / Local Only": 2}
- Access Models: {"Self-Serve Free / Trial": 55, "Self-Serve Dev + App Review": 20, "Admin / Customer Account Required": 9, "Self-Serve Paid Plan": 7, "Partner / Sales-Gated": 6, "Open-Source / Local Tool": 3}
- API Protocols: {"REST": 86, "REST + GraphQL": 7, "GraphQL": 3, "CLI / Local Only": 2, "RPC / Proprietary SDK": 1, "MCP Only": 1}
- MCP Status: {"Official MCP": 89, "None Found": 6, "Community MCP Only": 5}
- OpenAPI Spec Available: {"Unknown": 60, "Yes": 34, "No": 6}
- Webhooks Supported: {"Yes": 57, "Unknown": 40, "No": 3}
- Composio Live Catalog Coverage (1,842 toolkits audited): {"Built API Only": 54, "Both Built + Provider MCP": 22, "Not in Catalog": 19, "Provider MCP Only": 5}
- Live Composio Footprint: 14,555 tools, 32 managed OAuth apps, 23 trigger-enabled apps
- URL & Repo Verification: 432 live URLs checked ({"bot_shielded_403_429": 25, "ok_2xx_3xx": 392, "timeout_or_other": 15}); 16 GitHub MCP repos audited via Composio `github` toolkit
- Pass 2 Automated Corrections: 30 field fixes across 29 apps ({"openapi_spec_available": 8, "webhooks_supported": 10, "access_model": 5, "buildability_verdict": 2, "evidence_urls": 2, "api_protocol": 1, "mcp_status": 1, "auth_methods": 1})
- Human + Browser Audit (20-app stratified sample): Pass 1 exact accuracy 50.0% -> Pass 2 automated 80.0% -> Final audited 100.0%

## Key Patterns (7 Synthesized Findings)
1. **Dual-auth (OAuth2 + API Key/Bearer) is standard:** OAuth2 appears in 88/100 apps, API Key in 64, Bearer Token in 62; 86/100 apps expose 2+ auth schemes.
2. **Dev/Infra and Productivity stay nearly 100% self-serve:** Productivity and Project Management (9/10 ready), Developer, Infra and Data platforms (7/10 ready), and Communications and Messaging (7/10 ready) deliver the highest density of Ready Today builds.
3. **Hidden production gate trap:** 35/100 apps require app review, paying customer admin accounts, or partner contracts—concentrated in Finance and Fintech and Ecommerce (Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, WhatsApp Business, Amazon SP-API).
4. **Official MCP inflection:** 89/100 vendors ship official MCP servers (+5 community-only), led by CRM and Sales and Support and Helpdesk; some enterprise-gated apps (e.g., Otter AI) expose narrower self-serve OAuth MCP endpoints while gating REST.
5. **Non-API CLI edge cases:** 2 tools (Sherlock, Mermaid CLI) are local CLI binaries rather than hosted web APIs and require a hosted runner (Apify, Mermaid Chart MCP) or sandboxed workbench.
6. **Webhook-to-trigger headroom:** 57 vendors document webhooks, yet only 23 matched Composio toolkits ship triggers; 27 existing Composio toolkits support vendor webhooks today with 0 live triggers.
7. **Build vs. Wrap depth law:** Across the 22 apps shipping both Built API and Provider MCP in Composio, Built APIs average 195.8 tools vs. 68.8 for Provider MCP (2.8x deeper), dominating mature infra/payments (GitHub 883 vs 44, Stripe 428 vs 10, Vercel 399 vs 37). Provider MCPs outgun Built APIs on 7/22 mostly GraphQL or high-friction gated apps (Datadog, Ahrefs, higgsfield, Close, Linear, Ramp, Clay). The 5 Provider-MCP-only toolkits average 16.6 tools (median 12) with 0 triggers and 0 managed OAuth—an entry wedge rather than full parity.

## Strategic Composio Action Queues
- **Queue A — Net-New Easy Wins (7 apps; not in Composio + Ready Today):** LiveAgent, Vonage, systeme.io, WooCommerce, fanbasis, SE Ranking, Reducto
- **Queue B — Official MCP Expansion (49 apps; Built API Only in Composio + Official Vendor MCP):** Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Attio, Twenty, Podio, Zoho CRM, Copper, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Front, Help Scout, Gorgias, Slack, Twilio, Zoho Cliq, Lark (Larksuite), Pumble, WhatsApp Business, Aircall, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Pinterest, Shopify, BigCommerce, Gumroad, Amazon Selling Partner, DataForSEO, MrScraper, Firecrawl, Bright Data, Neo4j, Snowflake, Airtable, Jira, Asana, Coda, Smartsheet, Harvest, QuickBooks, Xero, Brex, PitchBook, NotebookLM, Fathom, YouTube Transcript, Grain
- **Queue C1 — Net-New Friction (6 apps; not in Composio + paywall/review/admin):** Gladly, Magento (Adobe Commerce), Squarespace, Ecwid, Binance, iPayX
- **Queue C2 — Net-New Partner/Outreach (4 apps; enterprise/sales-gated):** DealCloud, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Waterfall.io, Paygent Connect
- **Queue D1 — Net-New Non-API Blockers (2 apps; local CLI):** Sherlock, Mermaid CLI
- **Queue D2 — Trigger Expansion Candidates (27 apps; in Composio with vendor webhooks but 0 live triggers):** Attio, Twenty, Podio, Intercom, Freshdesk, Pylon, Help Scout, Zoho Cliq, Lark (Larksuite), Telegram, Aircall, GoHighLevel, Threads (Meta), SendGrid, BigCommerce, Gumroad, DataForSEO, Firecrawl, MongoDB Atlas, Sentry, Smartsheet, Plaid, Xero, Ramp, Otter AI, higgsfield, Grain
- **Build vs. Wrap Split (22 Both / 5 MCP Only):** Built API leads on 14/22 apps (top moat: GitHub 883 vs 44, MongoDB Atlas 496 vs 41, Stripe 428 vs 10, Vercel 399 vs 37, Sentry 210 vs 9, Supabase 230 vs 32); Provider MCP leads on 7/22 apps (Datadog 370 vs 255, Ahrefs 135 vs 46, higgsfield 101 vs 13, Close 114 vs 75, Linear 78 vs 47, Ramp 213 vs 186, Clay 17 vs 15); MCP Only (GoHighLevel (36), Devin (23), Pylon (12), Netlify (9), Otter AI (3)).

## Verification & Human-in-the-Loop Summary
- **3-Pass Pipeline:** Pass 1 (Exa `/search` + Composio `deepwiki_mcp` + Gemini structured Pydantic output) -> Pass 2 (HTTP link health + Exa `/contents` + disconfirmation search + live Composio v3.1 catalog cross-check + Composio `github` repo ownership audit + Gemini Critic) -> Pass 3 (20-app stratified live-docs & browser human audit across all 10 categories).
- **Key failure modes caught by human/browser review:** (1) Bot-shielded doc portals (Meta, LinkedIn, Cloudflare) returning HTTP 400/403/timeouts to headless link checkers; (2) Free sandbox portals mislabeled as `Self-Serve Free` when production requires business verification or app review; (3) Split-surface products (Otter AI Enterprise REST vs. 3-tool OAuth MCP; NotebookLM Consumer vs. GCP Enterprise); (4) Catalog alias & entity collisions (`linkedin` vs. `linkedin_ads`, `Paygent Connect` vs. Payman AI, Clay's 404 REST docs, FanBasis rebrand to Commas).

## JSON Schema Quick Reference (`data/final_results.json`)
- Top-level JSON array of 100 objects sorted by `id` (1..100).
- Core fields: `id`, `name`, `category`, `one_liner`, `auth_methods` (array), `auth_notes`, `access_model`, `access_notes`, `api_protocol`, `api_breadth`, `api_surface_notes`, `mcp_status`, `mcp_evidence_url`, `openapi_spec_available`, `webhooks_supported`, `buildability_verdict`, `primary_blocker`, `evidence_urls` (array), `confidence`.
- Live Composio & audit fields: `composio_catalog_slugs`, `composio_coverage`, `composio_tools_count`, `composio_triggers_count`, `composio_auth_modes`, `composio_managed_auth`, `github_mcp_audit`, `url_health`, `verification_changes`, `human_audited`.
- `buildability_verdict` enum: `Ready Today (Easy Win)` | `Buildable with Friction` | `Gated / Needs Outreach` | `Blocked / Not API-Native`.
- `composio_coverage` enum: `Built API Only` | `Both Built + Provider MCP` | `Provider MCP Only` | `Not in Catalog`.
